title: Shape of a captured configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a machine with $m$ work tapes over the Boolean alphabet, let $\iota$ embed its tape indices into the $k$ tape indices, and choose a tape index $\mathrm{cap}$ outside the image of $\iota$. Let $x,y$ be Boolean words, let $p$ be an input-head position for $x$, and let $s$ be a state of $M$. Suppose the tape contents on every embedded tape are blank at every cell. Embedding the initial configuration with state $s$, input-head position $p$, and output $y$ into the larger machine gives the initial configuration with the same state and input-head position, with $y$ buffered on tape $\mathrm{cap}$, that tape's head at position $|y|$, and every other tape and head as specified by the original tape contents and zero head positions.
